JW Calendar 0.1.0 brings an offline-first calendar and date utility to Linux.

- CLI month and year calendars with Sunday- or Monday-first layouts.
- Date details with weekday, ordinal day, leap-year status and ISO week-year.
- Separate tools for Julian calendar dates, Julian Day Numbers and day-of-year values.
- US federal holiday reference with legal and observed dates.
- Native GTK desktop month view, year overview and selected-date details.
- Strict-confinement Snap package, built and smoke-tested on Ubuntu 24.04.

## Snap Store status

Snap Store name registration has not been submitted. The Store form currently forces private registration while new names are reviewed, and this project requires a public listing. The public Store page is not available yet. Once public registration is enabled, install with `sudo snap install jwcalendar`.

For now, download the `.snap` asset attached to this GitHub release and install it locally:

```sh
sudo snap install --dangerous ./jwcalendar_0.1.0_amd64.snap
```
